blocks.text: It should also be mentioned that Buxdorf (s.v. ידעוני) cites Bodinus, who explains אדני שדה as the Greek Κατωβλέπας [katōblepas]; but according to Pliny (h. n. 8, 21, 32) this animal is a bull with a large, drooping head; an animal which, however, certainly cannot be meant in our Mishnah.
Finally, it should be noted that the fabulous animal, the basilisk, is not mentioned in the Talmud, but is erroneously assumed by Burdorf (see §. 119, note)
